title: Pullman house: one window a storey south of the entrance
items: On the Prairie Avenue front of 1729 Prairie, the part between the entrance and the 18th Street corner now has one window on each storey and one dormer above them, all on one line in the middle of the wall, as the photographs show it.

The narrow second window and its small dormer are gone from that face. The full-size Library of Congress scan shows them just around the corner, on the 18th Street side, where the house already has them.
